MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word means "younger sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 妹妹 mèimei
   B. 姐姐 jiějie
   C. 女儿 nǚ'ér
   D. 妈妈 māma

2. Which Chinese word means "this"? (1 mark)
   A. 这 zhè
   B. 那 nà
   C. 妹妹 mèimei
   D. 哥哥 gēge

3. Which two syllables blend to make 椅子? (1 mark)
   A. bīng and xiāng
   B. yǐ and zi
   C. diàn and shì
   D. zhuō and zi

4. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室在床。
   B. 在床卧室。
   C. 床卧室在。
   D. 床在卧室。

5. Which Chinese word means "today"? (1 mark)
   A. 休息 xiūxi
   B. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   C. 明天 míngtiān
   D. 今天 jīntiān

6. What do the three words 早饭, 午饭 and 晚饭 have in common? (1 mark)
   A. They are fruits
   B. They are drinks
   C. They are days
   D. They are names of meals

7. What does 摸 (mō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To brush teeth
   B. To cry
   C. To laugh, to smile
   D. To touch

8. Fill the blank: 我用嘴巴____。 (I use my mouth to speak.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 看
   C. 听
   D. 摸

9. Fill the blank: 太阳____大。 (The sun is very big.) (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 很
   C. 在
   D. 有

10. What does 今天天气很好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Sunday
   B. The weather is very good today
   C. I am going to school
   D. It rains today

11. Which sentence means "The sofa is beside the door."? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 浴室在花园旁边。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 沙发在门旁边。

12. Where is the garden in 花园在房子右边? (1 mark)
   A. On the right of the house
   B. Above the house
   C. On the left of the house
   D. Inside the house

13. In the syllable jiào, what is the initial? (1 mark)
   A. j
   B. o
   C. i
   D. ia

14. Fill the blank: 厨房里有____。 (There is a fridge in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱
   B. 床
   C. 电视
   D. 沙发

15. What does 在 (zài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kitchen
   B. Door
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Living room

16. What does 教堂 jiàotáng mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. Church
   C. House
   D. School

17. Which is the short form of 星期? (1 mark)
   A. 周
   B. 去
   C. 家
   D. 学

18. What does 学校 (xuéxiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To go
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Mosque
   D. School

19. What does 蛋糕 (dàngāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cake
   B. Friend
   C. Candle
   D. Plate

20. In reading aloud, what is stress? (1 mark)
   A. Stopping after every word
   B. Reading without tones
   C. Reading in a whisper
   D. Saying an important word a little stronger

21. What does 几 (jǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To play
   B. Everybody
   C. Gift
   D. Which number, how many

22. What does 喜欢 (xǐhuan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Dinner
   B. Apple
   C. To like
   D. Meat

23. What does 用 (yòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two (before a counting word)
   B. To use
   C. Ear
   D. Shoulder

24. Read the pinyin: huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The garden is on the right of the house.
   B. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. Where is the sofa?

25. Fill the blank: 窗户在门____。 (The window is above the door.) (1 mark)
   A. 左边
   B. 上面
   C. 旁边
   D. 下面

26. How many strokes does 好 have? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 4

27. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is this?
   B. There are five people in my family.
   C. This is my father.
   D. That is my younger brother.

28. What does 这 (zhè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older sister
   B. This
   C. Is, am, are
   D. Younger brother

29. How many strokes does 上 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 2

30. Which word completes 卧室里有____? (There is a bed in the bedroom.) (1 mark)
   A. 床
   B. 花园
   C. 桌子
   D. 冰箱

31. Which sentence means "The fridge is in the kitchen."? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 沙发在门旁边。
   C. 浴室在花园旁边。
   D. 冰箱在厨房。

32. What does 五 (wǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Five
   C. Nine
   D. Seven

33. What does 休息 (xiūxi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To rest
   B. Today
   C. Yesterday
   D. Church

34. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. 今天是星期天。
   B. 今天是星期三。
   C. 昨天是星期三。
   D. 明天是星期一。

35. What does 肉 (ròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Banana
   B. Grapes
   C. Meat
   D. Biscuits

36. Which Chinese word means "tooth"? (1 mark)
   A. 牙 yá
   B. 摸 mō
   C. 看 kàn
   D. 用 yòng

37. What does 错 cuò mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Wrong
   B. Right
   C. Today
   D. Rain

38. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn xiǎo. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is very light.
   B. The sun is very big.
   C. Today there are clouds.
   D. The rain is heavy.

39. What does 雪 (xuě) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flood
   B. Snow
   C. There is not
   D. Cloud

40. Which stroke is written first in 右? (1 mark)
   A. 竖 shù
   B. 点 diǎn
   C. 撇 piě
   D. 横 héng

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Say where the tone mark goes in these syllables: hǎo and liù. (2 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The door is on the left." (2 marks)

43. Name one kind of extreme weather. Say what causes it and give one safety tip. (4 marks)

44. Write "Happy birthday to you" in characters and pinyin. (2 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is on the table." (3 marks)

46. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喝 and 牙. (2 marks)

47. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nǐ ne? (2 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 七 and 云. (2 marks)

49. Write the Chinese for "I laugh" and "I cry" with pinyin. (2 marks)

50. Explain what stress is in reading aloud and give an example. (3 marks)

51. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my younger brother." (2 marks)

52. Write the eight basic strokes' names in Chinese with pinyin. Any six earn full marks. (3 marks)

53. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Who is this?" (2 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 客厅 and 咖啡. (2 marks)

55. Write the five weather words in pinyin. (3 marks)

56. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is in the living room." (2 marks)

57. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 左边 and 房间. (2 marks)

58. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the television?" (2 marks)

59. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." and "The bathroom is beside the garden." (4 marks)

60. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Thank you!" (2 marks)

61. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: yǔ hěn dà. (2 marks)

62. Write the stroke names of 手 in order. (3 marks)

63. Write the first two strokes of 右 and the first two strokes of 左. (3 marks)

64. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a bed in the bedroom." (2 marks)

65. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 吃 and 前面. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — 妹妹 mèimei
   妹妹 is a younger sister and 姐姐 is an older sister.

2. A — 这 zhè
   这 (zhè) means this.

3. B — yǐ and zi
   yǐ + zi = yǐzi, chair.

4. D — 床在卧室。
   The pattern is thing + 在 + place.

5. D — 今天 jīntiān
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

6. D — They are names of meals
   饭 is meal, and the first characters tell the time of day.

7. D — To touch
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

8. A — 说
   说 is to speak.

9. B — 很
   很 means very and goes before 大.

10. B — The weather is very good today
   天气 is weather and 很好 is very good.

11. D — 沙发在门旁边。
   沙发在门旁边。 (shāfā zài mén pángbiān.) means "The sofa is beside the door.".

12. A — On the right of the house
   右边 is the right side.

13. A — j
   j is the initial. iao is the final.

14. A — 冰箱
   The fridge is in the kitchen.

15. C — Is at, is in
   在 (zài) means is at, is in.

16. B — Church
   教堂 is a church.

17. A — 周
   周 zhōu means week and is used in 周一 and 周日.

18. D — School
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

19. A — Cake
   蛋糕 (dàngāo) means cake.

20. D — Saying an important word a little stronger
   Stress makes key words stand out but does not change the tone.

21. D — Which number, how many
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

22. C — To like
   喜欢 (xǐhuan) means to like.

23. B — To use
   用 (yòng) means to use.

24. A — The garden is on the right of the house.
   huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. is 花园在房子右边。, which means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

25. B — 上面
   上面 is above.

26. C — 6
   女 has 3 and 子 has 3.

27. B — There are five people in my family.
   wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. is 我家有五口人。, which means "There are five people in my family.".

28. B — This
   这 (zhè) means this.

29. C — 3
   上 has three strokes.

30. A — 床
   A bed belongs in the bedroom.

31. D — 冰箱在厨房。
   冰箱在厨房。 (bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.) means "The fridge is in the kitchen.".

32. B — Five
   五 (wǔ) means five.

33. A — To rest
   休息 (xiūxi) means to rest.

34. B — 今天是星期三。
   今天 is today.

35. C — Meat
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

36. A — 牙 yá
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

37. A — Wrong
   错 is wrong; 对 is right.

38. A — The wind is very light.
   fēng hěn xiǎo. is 风很小。, which means "The wind is very light.".

39. B — Snow
   雪 (xuě) means snow.

40. C — 撇 piě
   右 begins with the falling stroke.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: hǎo: on a. liù: on u (the second of iu).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example a flood: it is caused by too much heavy rain. Stay away from fast rivers. (A drought is caused by too little rain. Save water.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the event, 1 mark for the cause, 2 marks for a safety tip with a reason.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喝: hē, to drink. 牙: yá, tooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: And you?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 七: qī, seven. 云: yún, cloud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我笑 wǒ xiào; 我哭 wǒ kū.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stress means saying an important word a little stronger. For example in 我们切蛋糕, you may stress 蛋糕 to show what we cut. It does not change the tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for the tone note.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我弟弟。 nà shì wǒ dìdi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: 横 héng, 竖 shù, 撇 piě, 捺 nà, 点 diǎn, 提 tí, 横折 héngzhé, 竖钩 shùgōu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for six or more.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 客厅: kètīng, living room. 咖啡: kāfēi, coffee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: tàiyáng, yún, fēng, yǔ, xuě.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for all five.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在客厅。 diànshì zài kètīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: 左边: zuǒbian, left side. 房间: fángjiān, room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在哪儿? diànshì zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: The rain is heavy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four.

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: 右: 撇 then 横. 左: 横 then 撇.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct stroke pair and 1 mark for the difference.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: 卧室里有床。 wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

65. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吃: chī, to eat. 前面: qiánmiàn, in front of.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
